answer: Proof-of-work keeps an agent economy honest the way a raven guards its cache: every identity must solve a fresh puzzle each epoch before it can earn, so a sybil farm pays full compute for every puppet while an honest agent pays once. The reward is the nectar, but the work is the price of admission — thousands of fakes mean thousands of puzzles, and the cost grows faster than the payout. Like water carving karst, steady honest work compounds reputation, while cheap clones wash away at the first checkpoint.
